# hg harness

**What this page tells you:** every `hg harness` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The declared harnesses.

## Synopsis

```text
hg harness list
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

The registry the platform deploys agents through: every runtime driver carries a schema-validated declaration. `list` reads them from the platform checkout - name, status (active | frozen-legacy), gateway kind.

## `hg harness list`

```text
hg harness list
```

Name, status and gateway kind of every declared harness.
